emails.subject: Quotation Q-1042 Acknowledgement
emails.body:
Dear Shakti Precision Components,

We acknowledge receipt of your quotation Q-1042 dated [insert date].

Item A: 9mm brass casings - 2400 units in stock at depot FSD-14 (next dispatch: 2026-11-02)
Item B: field radio batteries - 1150 units in stock at depot FSD-09 (next dispatch: 2026-11-05)

Your quotation details:
Item A: 500 units @ INR 120
Item B: 200 units @ INR 850

As a VIP vendor, we require this information for depot scheduling. Our procurement decision will be finalized within 3 working days.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
[Your Name/Designation]
